title: Robert Schoch's solar flare and Lichtenberg figure idea

tellings.quote: but he thinks that the Giza plateau was hit by a solar flare

plain: A researcher named Robert Schoch thinks the Giza plateau, the site of the great pyramids in Egypt, was once hit by a solar flare, a huge burst of energy from the sun. The idea ties to Lichtenberg figures, the branching tree-like marks that electrical discharges such as lightning leave behind. Geoffrey Drumm, a guest who studies the purpose of the pyramids, passes it on as what Schoch believes, and if true it would mean the site carries the scars of a great electrical event.
